name: Logic · Fallacies
description: Spot common reasoning errors by name, from straw men and slippery slopes to ad hominem attacks and red herrings.

cards.front: Attacking the person instead of their argument
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Misrepresenting an opponent's view to defeat it
cards.label: fallacy
cards.hook: Like fighting a flimsy dummy instead of the real opponent

cards.front: Presenting only two options when more exist
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Assuming that because B followed A, A caused B
cards.label: fallacy
cards.hook: Latin for 'after this, therefore because of this'

cards.front: Believing something is true because many people believe it
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Drawing a broad conclusion from too few examples
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Claiming one small step will inevitably lead to disaster
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Using the conclusion itself as one of the premises
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Changing the subject to an irrelevant distraction
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Claiming something is false because nobody has proven it
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Redefining a group to exclude every counterexample
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Using a word with two meanings as if it had one
cards.label: fallacy
cards.hook: Like 'bank' meaning a riverside and a place for money

cards.front: Replying to criticism with 'you do it too'
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Assuming something natural must be good or safe
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Asking a question that assumes an unproven answer
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Changing the criteria after the goal has been met
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Judging an idea by where or who it came from
cards.label: fallacy

cards.front: Accepting a claim only because an authority said it
cards.label: fallacy
